trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are all done. Work through the five Roadmap stages in order and keep the Checklist ticked as you go, so nothing is left behind for the end. There is no shortcut — every trophy in this list feeds this one. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn — just follow the mission prompts and finish it. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapters run in order, so keep playing the story missions as they appear and this comes naturally. It is tied to the story, so there is no way to earn it outside the chapter. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to a story chapter — the official list does not say chapters can be replayed, so finish the chapter's missions while they are open.

The official list does not name the mission or say whether it can be replayed, so go in prepared and finish it when it opens. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own checklist. That means finishing the story, the side strands, the activities and the collectibles — everything this guide tracks. PSN counts it to 100, so watch the in-game completion percentage and use the Roadmap view here to find what is still open. This is the last big gate before the platinum. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 100% count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all count toward the total, and PSN tracks it to 250. The fastest way is to keep stunting whenever you drive: take jumps at speed, thread traffic, and use the open roads outside the city for long air time. It builds up across the whole game, so start early and it will be done long before the end. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 250 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once. The game counts each type the first time you play it — races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, meditation, drone races, WAiNK, cards and the rest of the activities in this list. Open the Activities filter here to see them all, and tick each off as you try it. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 9 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores accuracy and speed, so take them one at a time and replay any that fall short — the range can be revisited, and gold needs a clean run rather than a fast one. PSN tracks it to 42, so count the golds as you go. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 42 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race; you need a win at every one, not just one win. Learn each course's line — drone races reward a clean racing line more than raw speed — and work through the locations one by one. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 14 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins across the race types — road races, drone races and any other race the game offers. Repeat wins on the same race do not add to it, so keep moving to races you have not won yet. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 20 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are timing and patience — watch the line, reel when the fish runs, and do not force it. The official list does not name where the challenge happens or when it opens, so take it when the fishing activity offers the challenge against Cal. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game to the end. Any arcade game counts — pick one, learn its rules, and play it through. Arcades are found around Leonida; the official list does not name a specific machine, so any completed game earns it. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Andy's strand builds through his earlier missions, so keep taking his jobs as they appear until the last one opens, then complete it. The official list does not say the mission can be replayed, so finish it while it is open. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to a character's final mission — the official list does not say it can be replayed, so finish it while it is open.

trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear with a marker on the map — take each strand and play it through; you need 8 complete strands, and PSN tracks it to 8. They are spread across the state, so explore outside Vice City too, and keep an eye out for strangers while travelling between story missions. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 8 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered around the state — visit each one and meditate there. PSN tracks it to 18, so count them as you go; the spots are spread out, so fold them into your exploration rather than hunting them all at once. The official list does not give the spots' locations, so explore thoroughly. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 18 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunts ask for a specific animal — track it, take it down, and bring the hunt to a close. The official list does not name the animal or where it roams, so take the hunt when Bret offers it and follow his lead in the game. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida — pick them up as you explore, and each full set counts; you need 3 sets in total, and PSN tracks it to 3. Keep the cards you find; a set is only complete when every card in it is collected. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 3 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is a check-in style activity — open it at a new spot and it counts; PSN tracks it to 100, so you need 100 different locations. Fold it into everything else: check in whenever you arrive somewhere new, and the count climbs on its own. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 100 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small goals — stunts, driving, combat and more — and they tick off as you play; PSN tracks it to 50. You do not need to hunt them specially at first: play normally, check the challenge list now and then, and mop up the ones that are left near the end. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 50 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then lose it and escape. You need your partner with you for this one — get the heat up together, then break line of sight and stay out of the search until the stars clear. Doing it with a fast car and open roads helps. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time. The trick is the opposite of Hot Together: do not lose the heat between shops. Hit one shop, move straight to the next, and keep your partner with you — three in a row without the wanted level dropping earns it. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Getting into a vehicle you have not found before adds it to the count, and PSN tracks it to 100 — repeats do not count. Drive everything you see: traffic, parked cars, boats and bikes all add new models, so keep trying new ones as you travel. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 100 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends — a crowded fight is the time to try it. If you fall short, the next fight is another chance; it only needs one clean run. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA (Vice City International Airport) in an unscheduled way — take a plane and get out without following the normal departure. The official list does not say which aircraft or route, so grab a plane at the airport and leave on your own terms. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank — the description is a nod to taking the tank for a spin. The official list does not say where the Rhinos are or what exactly counts, so find a Rhino, get in, and see the heat through; the trophy is tied to the tank itself. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Go in quiet: avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take what you came for, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — back out and try again. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Each vault needs a clean getaway — get in, take the money, and get clear before the law closes in. You need 5 escapes, and PSN tracks it to 5, so count them as you go. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 5 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the money, and get away clean before the response arrives. A quiet road and a fast getaway car make it much easier than trying it in the middle of the city. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited, and PSN counts it to 52 — drive through every district, island and back road until the map is full. Fold it into the other exploration trophies: visiting new areas is also where you find new vehicles, cards and meditation spots. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 52 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations around Leonida — hit one operation for each gang, and PSN tracks it to 9. The official list does not name the gangs or their operations, so take the operations as you find them and keep count of which gangs you have hit. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 9 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail — the trophy is about the moment, not a challenge. Any time works; it is not tied to a mission. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Pick a showroom, get in a car, and leave through the glass — the messier the exit, the better. It can be done any time, so save it for a moment when you do not mind the heat. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through. Head to the alley, start a game, and bowl it out — the trophy is about playing the game, not winning it. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one is about a partnership moment with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, and the official list gives no steps. It is tied to doing something notable with your partner; keep playing the partner content and it will come. We have not pinned down the exact trigger, and this guide will not guess at one. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — PSN tracks a count to 500, so this is a long-haul trophy that fills up as you play through the story and side content. Every decision point adds to it, so there is nothing special to do except keep playing and choosing; it will land near the end of a full playthrough. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 500 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something you failed the first time. The description points at a retry — fail once, then get it right on the next try. The official list does not name what must be retried, so play normally; a failed attempt followed by a success is part of any playthrough, and this will come on its own. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The description points at an odd, unexpected moment in the world — something out of the ordinary that you stumble across while playing. The official list does not say what or where, so keep exploring and it will find you; this guide will not invent a location for it. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive past on a bike or in a car and swing a melee weapon as you pass — the drive-by needs to connect. A slow pass through a crowded street gives you the best chance to land it. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies — take them to your contacts to wash them, and PSN tracks the total to $250,000. It adds up across the whole game, so keep laundering as you earn; the big story scores move the total fastest. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the $250,000 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars, food — every shop purchase counts toward the total, and PSN tracks it to $100,000. It builds up naturally if you buy what you need, and near the end you can top it up with big purchases. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the $100,000 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought around Leonida — each one you own adds storage and counts toward the total, and PSN tracks it to 8. They cost money, so fold the purchases into the money stage of the roadmap once your funds are up. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 8 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the app, and register each one — PSN tracks it to 10. Any vehicle counts, so register the ones you drive anyway and the count will be done quickly. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 10 count; the steps above are our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.
